sources.title: 腐り姫 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Directly inspected complete 124-step Japanese walkthrough by Fool, dated 2004-02-12. The author identifies tested version as 「不明（修正後）」, i.e. the corrected original PC release family, rather than the 2015 Selection DVD. Full TRUE 35, END1 44, END2 45 sequence; exact menu labels for three endings, 3 CG save/load pairs, same-run 本編からはじめる and new-playthrough 既視感→記憶を失う, post-ending bonus CG guidance. The precise installer/update revision isn't specified; independently compare patch-specific features in original publisher correction notice. Set A is not claimed independently duplicated verbatim by B.

sources.title: 腐り姫 True End への道
sources.notes: Independent original-era Japanese TRUE END guide, directly inspected. First-to-fourth shell choice path ends with exact 「……終わりじゃない。」, same terminal as Set A. Earlier choice substitutions are: (1) 「……どうかしたかい？」 vs A 「うん。電話の相手はね…」, (2) 「米軍誘致でしょう」 vs A 「ただ酒の呑める町」, (3) 「母さんだ」 vs A 「芳野さんだ」, (4) 「それでも僕は…迷い続ける」 vs A 「自分の暗い過去を感じた」; it also chooses 「潤にキスをした」/「かなえてこそ、夢」 within a later shell where A instead has the post-save branch. Both explicitly reach TRUE END, so these are likely alternative scene paths, not mutually exclusive mandatory route-defining choices; however a full same-state/2015 parity proof is still missing. Does not cover END1, END2, or CG cleanup.

sources.title: 〖腐り姫 ～euthanasia～〗感想 - ひっそりと群生
sources.notes: Read directly. CORRECTION: this author explicitly credits the 愚者の館 walkthrough (Set A) at the foot of the article. The report's TRUE END → END1 → END2 order, advice and completion cannot be treated as INDEPENDENT Set B confirmation. Kept only as derivative usage evidence. Other personal impressions may be original, but this is not verification-lane support.

sources.title: 腐り姫（ライアーソフト） - プレイ感想
sources.notes: Independent early Japanese first-hand technical report: ending completion makes normal 本編からはじめる unable to advance, 既視感→記憶を失う resets saves/progression, loaded saves may be reinterpreted by flags, and CG/story completion requires multiple runs. Does not independently provide precise ending routes.

sources.notes: Independent Japanese player advice: 盲点 must be enabled for CG completion in the original patched game; early edition could block at 第二殻 without official patch, and read-skip survives reset only after patch. Not a complete choice-route source.

sources.notes: Official publisher's corrected-original patch notice, 2002-03-14: fixes 盲点 and permits read state to survive 記憶を失う; early saves may be incompatible. sources.title: Repost of 愚者の館 walkthrough
sources.notes: Directly inspected exact-sequence mirror of Fool's Set A; explicitly EXCLUDED as independent Set B. It reproduces the same list and ending structure.

sources.title: 個人的な『腐り姫』感想メモ - マイマイゾンビ
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese 2025 play report. Describes the final THREE outcome choices semantically: 「共に在り続ける」 (= Set A END1 terminal 「蔵女と共に、生き続けよう。」), 「在ることを終える」 (= Set A END2 「お開きにしよう。」), and 「二人で全てを忘れて生きていく」 (= Set A TRUE END 「……終わりじゃない。」). No visible attribution to Fool; original first-hand commentary. Confirms decision/outcome semantics, NOT literal in-game Japanese choice texts for END1/END2, nor intermediate run/CG/saves or precise 2015 Selection parity.

sources.title: 腐り姫~euthanasia~ 感想 - 最果てバイブル
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent player report labels three outcomes 落果 (endless coexistence), 腐爛 (mutual cessation), and リフレーン (memory/power reset, called TRUE elsewhere). Reader says they played 落果 → 腐爛 then reset and saw a third option leading リフレーン: 「上2つのエンドを見てから、記憶を消して再度プレイし出現させた第三の選択肢」. This potentially signals an unlock/flag dependency; Set A instead lists TRUE as its first complete run. We have NOT proved whether third choice strictly requires prior two endings, appears as result of particular branch flags, or whether both pathways are valid. This is a MATERIAL unresolved research uncertainty; do not suppress it.

sources.title: 腐り姫〜euthanasia〜 感想 - よろずブログ (2026 DMM download play)
sources.notes: Directly inspected 2026-06-22 first-hand play on a RECENT DMM download release; author explicitly identifies their release as D◯MのDL版. Reports no heroine-specific end routes (キャラクタールートエンディングというものは無い), three story endings (ストーリーエンディングは三種類), nonrandom 4-day loops, and a terminal choice after these loops. This is strong post-2015 Japanese evidence that narrative structure persists in modern downloads, but it is NOT the selected 2015 Windows DVD Selection edition and it does not print exact choices.

sources.title: 「腐り姫」プレイ感想3 - よくなじむブログ (2013 MegaStore edition)
sources.notes: Directly indexed Japanese first-hand report of MegaStore 2013 included edition. Explicitly observes 「各所に選択肢がありますが、どれを選んでもストーリーは進行します」 and warns that some choices skip certain character subplots. Supports treating many intermediate choices as non-main-ending scene variations, but not necessarily CG-irrelevant; no full END1/END2 choice path. Separate part 4 of same report identifies edition and the long loop progression. Verify if a reviewer wants to use this component as formal B.

sources.title: 『腐り姫～euthanasia～』レビュー - マダツボミの観察日記
sources.notes: Japanese independent first-hand analysis in indexed excerpt: no conventional BADEND, most choices change local scenes but not major forward story; ending is determined by main-story ending selection, reporter reached TRUE after two resets. Direct page fetch currently redirect-loops; DO NOT COUNT AS directly inspected qualifying B until reachable (indexed excerpts only).

sources.title: 腐り姫～euthanasia～ 攻略＆レビュー (2010)

sources.title: 2015 Japanese Selection first impressions

sources.title: 腐り姫 ～euthanasia～（bellwood independent Japanese first-person review）
sources.notes: Directly inspected original Japanese firsthand narrative review, independent of Fool; it explicitly describes the TRUE/リフレーン outcome by referring to the selected menu text 「終わりじゃない」 without leading/trailing punctuation. Corroborates the existence/semantics of the TRUE-choice outcome, NOT its exact typography, optional scene choices, END1/END2 choices, or 2015 Selection applicability. This is supplementary B only, not a full walkthrough.

sources.title: 腐り姫～euthanasia～感想（右肩下がりのドクターイエロー）
sources.notes: Independent Japanese first-person completion report, read via indexed search excerpt; describes three endings and reset, and the successive four-day loops. Direct open redirects in this environment, therefore indexed-only provenance, NOT a directly inspectable required Set B component.

sources.title: 腐り姫 ～euthanasia～ (Antipyretic, 2016-02-19)
sources.notes: Directly inspected 2016 original Japanese first-hand report of the official Windows DL edition, NOT identified as 2015 Selection DVD. Explicitly says 「システムは DL 版を買ったのでバグはない」, confirms 4-day in-game loop continuation, the 記憶を失う-system style and configurable 盲点, and refers to リフレーン/腐爛 story endings. This is independent *modern-release mechanics and ending-structure* corroboration, but not literal Japanese END1/END2 choices and not direct proof of 2015 Selection's script/saves.

sources.title: 降り積もる赤い雪と繰り返される真夏の4日間 (2016 Japanese review)
sources.notes: Japanese original first-hand report indexed and directly available as a search result. Says 「盲点」 ON reveals interstitial comedy, recommends OFF on the first reading for atmosphere, and notes postclear content and laborious CG collection. No full choice walkthrough. Do not assert it grants source coverage for END1/END2.

sources.title: 腐り姫 プレイ感想１ (2013 first-run menu timing)
sources.notes: Japanese firsthand play report located by indexed excerpt, but the direct site fetch is a redirect loop, therefore NOT an inspectable verification set. Says after the FIRST FOUR-DAY loop, title-screen 既視感 and the 「盲点」 toggle become available. Used for cautious practical timing note, not the route-source gate.

sources.title: 腐り姫 プレイ感想４ (2013 post-story 盲点 cleanup)
sources.notes: Indexed 2013 personal run report (direct URL redirect-looped), says after first full story conclusion the author resets using 記憶を消す and enables 盲点 to collect remaining choices/CGs over ~4-day ×10 internal loops; confirms a full replay may be required if it was OFF. Not directly inspectable; NOT a Set B gate component.

sources.title: Liar-soft official download-edition technical specification
sources.notes: DIRECT publisher technical evidence: original 2002 package is 640×480/high-color, but official 2007 Download edition was converted to 800×600/full-color, plus Windows XP/Vista support. This proves a real engineering/asset difference across editions; cannot assume untouched code/scripts/flags in 2015 Selection. It does NOT say exact 2015 DVD uses the 2007 DL code or preserves 2002 patch logic; not a route-evidence Set B.

sources.title: 2017 Japanese Liar-soft support thread: Selection 01 compared with download edition
sources.notes: DIRECTLY INSPECTED 2017/10/31 posts #233–235. User specifically asks whether 2015 Selection 01 腐り姫 window resolution is same as downloadable edition's 800×600; another user replies 「そうです」 and the asker acknowledges. This is release-target-specific Japanese player evidence for 800×600 display parity with the 2007+ DL edition, rather than original 640×480. It is a short, anonymous forum answer and does NOT establish that scenario choices, endings, patches, reset flags, or CGs are identical. Counts only toward release/technical presentation, not choice-step coverage.

sources.title: 『腐り姫~euthanasia~』感想 - エロゲ日記（2022 DLsite プレイ）
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese firsthand play report dated 2022-03-04, played the DLsite edition. It confirms 本編からはじめる advances the 4-day loops, a memory wipe/replay is necessary for missed scenes, 盲点 was enabled on the second playthrough, and TRUE END unlocks 狐の嫁入り. The author loosely calls some intermediate character-arc conclusions 'endings'; that description is NOT verified as an additional staff-roll story ending and cannot override the three-main-story-end sources. Supports mechanics/bonus only, NOT literal END1/END2 UI options or 2015 Selection 01 DVD parity.

sources.title: 〖腐り姫 ~euthanasia~〗感想 — えろげりあん（2023）
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent 2023-09-09 first-person Japanese play/review; says 「EDは3種類」, distinguishes TRUE 「リフレーン」 and refers to another ending as 「お開き」. This is supporting evidence for the END2 outcome/name fragment only, NOT a verbatim print of the full literal selection 「お開きにしよう。」, choice availability, exact sequence, state flags, or the 2015 Selection 01 DVD. No explicit citation to Set A found on this page. Do not put this shorthand in jpGuide2 as if it were the exact END2 menu text.

sources.title: MEMENTO [腐り姫] ロッカー禁止（2015-03-18 firsthand play diary）
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese firsthand 2015-03-18 play diary. Author notes 「タイトル画面に発生するアイテムが見たエンディングごとに違う」 and that indiscriminately checking every scene choice caused a stalled progression until focusing on a particular thread of choices. Related March entry identifies play through MegaStore supplemental edition, BEFORE the 2015-11-27 Selection DVD. Supports earlier-release state-dependent menus and choice-path caution only; does not provide exact final ending-choice texts, a universal TRUE unlock sequence, or Selection 01 parity. This is independent firsthand reporting, not a second full route transcript.

sources.title: 駿河屋 腐り姫～euthanasia～ original Windows CD LIAR-006 (2002-02-08)
sources.notes: Directly checked release-specific Japanese storefront/archive identifies first Japanese Windows CD package 2002-02-08, LIAR-006, JAN 4560103850033, with bundled correction floppy.
